OpcodeControl.doc: Control-flow opcodes: unconditional jump, boolean-guarded jumps, null-guarded jump, bounded-depth Gosub/Return.

If.doc: If register cond_reg is truthy, jump to target; else continue.

IfNot.doc: If register cond_reg is falsy, jump to target; else continue.

JumpIfNull.doc: If register reg holds Value::Null, jump to target; else continue.

Gosub.doc: Push current PC+1 onto the return stack, then jump to target.

Return.doc: Pop the return stack; jump to the popped PC.

execute.doc: Execute one control opcode against the state. Returns Continue, Jump(target), or Halt(Error(OpcodeIllegal)) on return-stack underflow/overflow.
